query: Who won the November 2025 New York City mayoral election?
answer:
Zohran Mamdani, the Democratic nominee and a 34-year-old democratic socialist, won the New York City mayoral election on November 4, 2025. He beat former Governor Andrew Cuomo, who ran as an independent, and Republican Curtis Sliwa [1][2]. One secondary source gives the vote as about 50.4% for Mamdani, 41.6% for Cuomo and 7.1% for Sliwa, but I didn't check those numbers against the official certified count. More than 2 million people voted, the first time a mayoral race has passed that mark since 1969 [2]. Mamdani took office on January 1, 2026. He is the city's first Muslim mayor and its youngest since 1892 [2][3].

A few low-quality pages in the search results said Eric Adams won. Every major outlet contradicts that, so I ignored them.
